newsitem.title: USA: Rohatyn sworn in as U.S. envoy to France.
newsitem.headline: Rohatyn sworn in as U.S. envoy to France.

text.p: New York investment banker Felix Rohatyn was sworn in on Tuesday as the new U.S. ambassador to France, the State Department said.
Rohatyn, an internationally recognised expert in corporate mergers and acquisitions, public policy and business economics, was nominated last July by President Bill Clinton.
He retired earlier this year as managing director of the New York investment house Lazard, Freres & Co.
He succeeds Pamela Harriman, who died last February.
